name: Conrad Birgert
bioAdditions: FamilySearch has 'Conradt Birgert', born in 1588 at Fockenberg-Limbach, married to Anna Eva Jacob (b. 1593), and father of Elisabetha (1618-1685) (S1). It carries the line back to Hans Konrad Birckhert (1535-1605) and Barbara Ibelheupt, without sources visible for that generation. His name appears in the indexed 1642 marriage of his daughter to Caspar Grub ('Conradt Birkhert') and in a Lutheran baptism entry (S1).
